scope: Opt-in receipt mode on existing Mini App owner uploads; only three new owner GET reconciliation routes. No P18 mutations, viewer, camera or location endpoints.

headers.Idempotency-Key: stable UUID for exactly one user-approved upload
headers.X-Upload-SHA256: lowercase SHA-256 of actual file bytes

upload.body_transport: multipart/form-data; let the client supply its boundary
upload.replay: Same key plus identical fingerprint returns the stored owner HTTP status/body, after current authorization. No second attachment or scanner/storage call. Idempotent-Replay:true.
upload.conflict: 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT for changed file/parent/metadata under the same actor/key; 409 UPLOAD_SESSION_MISMATCH for reuse across new logins.
upload.unknown_repeat: 409 UPLOAD_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN. CHECK_ONLY; do not upload again, even with the same key, while completion is unknown.
upload.legacy: No X-Upload-Contract retains existing owner behavior without durable upload receipt guarantees. Never apply new reconciliation as a fallback for a legacy attempt.
upload.quota_concurrency: Opt-in uploads serialize on the owner parent. Legacy uploads have not been migrated to this journal and mixed-mode quota concurrency is not certified. Production must not assume all clients opted in.

reconcile.pending_meaning: Intent exists, but no terminal receipt. It is NOT evidence that a worker is still running; outward outcome remains UNKNOWN, no artificial TTL or failure inference.
reconcile.rejected_semantics: Durable owner rejection, NOT a universal NOT_RECORDED claim. It may reference a QUARANTINED audit row; inspect attachment_status_at_completion and current owner metadata.
reconcile.unknown_semantics: Absent receipt/current list/null/404/100% uploaded bytes/abort/hash match never prove success or rollback.
reconcile.receipt_vs_current: Receipt attachment ID/status/version/scan_result is historical; current_attachment is a fresh observation. Neither grants binary access without owner download ACL.
reconcile.scope: Exact actor+stable auth session+parent+warehouse+operation key+file hash. Changed identity returns 409 REQUEST_IDENTITY_MISMATCH; different actor/new session receives no old receipt.
reconcile.permissions_warranty: (warranty.view OR warranty.manage) AND documents.read plus P09 persisted owner/organization scope
reconcile.trace_identity: meta.request_id / X-Request-ID is an HTTP trace, not this upload operation_key. P09 UPDATE receipts separately use the original X-Request-ID UUID, not Idempotency-Key.

abort_policy: Client abort only stops waiting/transport. Server may complete later. P18 never calls DELETE as cancel and never sets server CANCELLED from a local button.

cleanup.caught_failures: Attachment row and receipt share a transaction. A tracked blob is removed only after checking the allocated attachment row is absent and no terminal receipt committed. Failed cleanup leaves operator work.
cleanup.crash_or_database_outage: PENDING/UNKNOWN plus the reserved attachment_id is retained. No automatic re-execution or blind deletion. Authorized operator reconciliation must inspect DB and owner storage prefix before orphan cleanup; no cleanup HTTP endpoint is added.
cleanup.retention: No automatic receipt purge in v1; operations capacity/retention policy remains an explicit deployment requirement. Do not purge an UNKNOWN request just to allow reuse.

document.attachment_type_policy: Business purpose enum, not MIME. Canonical controller remains authoritative; verify enum against deployment.

scanner.unconfigured: Existing owner returns UNSCANNED; not a malware pass. Production scanner policy/config must be verified before activation.
scanner.quarantined: Native malware/scanner-failure rejection retains a QUARANTINED audit row and no downloadable byte content.

policies.infrastructure: PHP upload_max_filesize/post_max_size, reverse proxy body/time limits, private storage credentials/capacity and scanner executable/timeouts need real operator evidence; application constants do not configure these systems.

handover.rules: Keep existing COMPLETED to RETURNED guard, exact owner permission/scope/version/component-posted validation and existing note field. Do not serialize missing structured fields into note. UI note200 is not proof of the owner storage limit. returned_at is server time, not a user-entered handover date.

location.rules: No warehouse-stock/location_hint projection as pallet/tray/bin grid; no fabricated slots/capacity/free/units; no move API or select-as-write.

binary_access.rules: Only exact attachment ID under a permitted parent and ACTIVE content through owner download. QUARANTINED/DELETED or 401/403 must not fall back to cached bytes. Verify Content-Type/Disposition/nosniff/cache/size/checksum on actual deployment. Do not attach access tokens to arbitrary or redirected cross-host URLs. FE revokes object URLs and clears viewer cache at context/session change.

remaining_gate: Owner/BA approval for structured handover and location requirements
Exact-commit CI with SQLite and PostgreSQL
Release ancestry and upload journal migration evidence
Authenticated upload/read/deny/timeout/storage/scanner/limits smoke with explicitly authorized files/accounts
UI abort/late callback/session and viewer/device UAT
test_policy: CI uses disposable local databases and generated harmless files only. No tests/migrations/seed data on DEV to manufacture evidence. Do not weaken assertions or bypass Composer security audit.
